titles.title: Banning Microtargeted Political Ads Act of 2021

To amend the Federal Election Campaign Act of 1971 to prohibit covered online platforms from disseminating political advertisements which are targeted to an individual, a connected device, or to a group of individuals or connected devices on any basis other than the recognized place in which the individual resides or the device is located, and for other purposes.
Banning Microtargeted Political Ads Act of 2021
